title: Petite Palm Vacation Rental
meta_description: Petite Palm is a 5.00 bedroom, 4.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: DescriptionPetite PalmMagnolia Dune Community – Sandalwood Dr, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459Home Highlights:5 Bedrooms (see “Room Details” for configurations)4 Full BathroomsSleeps 12 Guests2,341 Sq. Ft.Paved Grill Area with Outdoor ShowerSpacious Open Floor Kitchen with Stainless Steel Appliances & Marble Countertops1st Floor King Guest Bedroom with Private Full Bath & Walk-In Shower2nd Floor King Master Suite with Walk-In Closet & Full Bath (Double Vanity & Walk-In Shower)2nd Floor King Guest Suite with Private Full Bath & Walk-In Shower2nd Floor Queen Guest Bedroom with Shared Hall Bath2nd Floor Bunk Room with Shared Hall BathTwo–Three Vehicle DrivewaySix-Seater Golf CartFour 26" Adult Bikes Included Seasonally (Dec–Feb not included; additional rentals available)About the Home:Luxuriously designed by Kate Marker Interiors, Petite Palm perfectly embodies Seagrove Beach’s curated, casual coastal style. The home features four elegant adult bedrooms (three kings, one queen) plus a bonus bunk room, comfortably sleeping up to 12 guests. Vaulted ceilings and wall-mounted TVs in every bedroom, including the bunk room, create a relaxing, modern retreat.The open-concept kitchen is a chef’s dream with marble backsplash and countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a commercial-size refrigerator/freezer. Ample island and dining seating flow seamlessly to a screened porch for outdoor dining. Three additional porches, including a double porch swing, provide inviting spots to unwind. An outdoor shower adds beachside convenience.Explore Seagrove with four included adult bikes or take a dip in the nearby heated community pool. With two beach access points just across the street, Petite Palm offers the ultimate coastal getaway.Community Amenities:Community Pool (heated during Thanksgiving, Christmas, and March for Spring Break)Two Community Beach Access Points (Beachwood Villas & Seagrove Place, 0.2 mi / 3–4 min walk; pedestrian only)Closest beach access with parking: Santa Clara Regional Beach Access, 3 min driveGolf Cart & Parking:Six-seater golf cart provided for guest use (subject to availability; not guaranteed by 30A Cottages)Driveway parking for 2–3 vehicles; street parking not allowedNo house trailers, modular structures, or travel trailers permittedPolicies & Booking Info:No SmokingNo Pets (service animals allowed with prior notice & documentation)Rates do not include tax and fees50% due at booking, balance due 60 days prior (or full if within 60 days)Cancelations: 5% fee; initial 50% refundable if canceled >60 days priorOptional travel insurance available (purchase before final payment)Check-in: 4:00 PM CST | Check-out: 10:00 AM CSTGuests must be 25+ years old
